rotated_filled_rect.how: Playground computes the affine and transforms corners; pygame.draw.polygon fills.
rotated_filled_rect.cost: Transform math lives entirely in Playground - pygame contributes nothing here.

rotated_stroked_rect.defect: Edges are drawn as separate thick segments: joins are notched/gapped, no miter/round/bevel control, stroke alignment differs from every vector model.

rotated_ellipse.possible: only by flattening to a polygon in Playground
rotated_ellipse.how: 64-segment polygonisation done in Python; pygame.draw.ellipse cannot rotate.

antialiasing.stroke: aalines is 1px only - no anti-aliased thick stroke exists

clip_to_rotated_shape.how: set_clip accepts only a Rect; arbitrary-path clipping needs a mask + per-pixel blend (pygame.mask / surfarray) - i.e. a rasteriser written in Playground.

rotated_text.how: render bitmap then pygame.transform.rotate -> resampled, blurry at small sizes, no outline access, no hinting under transform.

translucent_fill.possible: only via a temporary SRCALPHA surface per shape
translucent_fill.how: Direct draw ignores alpha (left/red shape opaque); right/blue shape used a temp surface.

bezier_path.how: No curve primitive; Playground would flatten cubic/quadratic curves itself.
